title: The Sensitive skin of the child
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：sensitive　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sensitive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the musician wrote of ① a sensitive skin of the child in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so sensitive that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the sensitive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the sensitive skin of the child that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too sensitive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the sensitive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a sensitive ear for music, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as sensitive as the ear for music they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was sensitive or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something sensitive, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite sensitive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the sensitive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, without complaint, she wrote of another sensitive skin of the child in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less sensitive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The sensitive ear for music that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the sensitive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 敏感（前置定语 a sensitive skin of the child：1956 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件敏感的皮肤）
B. adj. 敏感／善解人意（两处加强说法：so sensitive that … 与 no less sensitive than …）
C. adj. 敏感／善解人意（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 敏感（表语 too sensitive to do：母亲觉得它太敏感，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 善解人意（前置定语 a sensitive ear for music：叔叔把整件事称作一桩善解人意的耳朵）
F. adj. 善解人意（同级比较 as sensitive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对音乐敏感的耳朵相比）
G. adj. 善解人意（后置定语 something sensitive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 善解人意（受程度副词修饰 quite sensitive：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a sensitive skin of the child
the sensitive skin of the child that
The sensitive ear for music that

answers.why: sensitive 意为“敏感”，1956 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件敏感的皮肤”，此处作前置定语 a sensitive skin of the child。
sensitive 意为“敏感”，此处用 so sensitive that 结构，说它敏感到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
sensitive 意为“敏感”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的敏感孩子敏感的皮肤，等于最高级的说法。
sensitive 意为“敏感”，母亲认为这件东西“太敏感了，谁也用不上”，too sensitive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩善解人意的耳朵”，此处作前置定语 a sensitive ear for music。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对音乐敏感的耳朵一样善解人意”，同级比较用 as sensitive as。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，节目单上那半行字要的是“善解人意的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something sensitive。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当善解人意”，quite 修饰原级 sensitive。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，no less sensitive than 表示“其善解人意不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之善解人意不亚于任何人的预料。
sensitive 意为“善解人意”，母亲 1968 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的善解人意耳朵”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件敏感的皮肤。（a sensitive skin of the child）
它敏感到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so sensitive that …）
母亲觉得它太敏感，谁也用不上。（too sensitive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩善解人意的耳朵。（a sensitive ear for music）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对音乐敏感的耳朵一样善解人意。（as sensitive as …）
到了 1963 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件善解人意的东西。（something sensitive）
answers: In 1956 the musician wrote of a sensitive skin of the child in the programme.
It was so sensitive that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too sensitive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a sensitive ear for music.
He said nobody would call it as sensitive as the ear for music they had once had.
By 1963 the programme asked for nothing but something sensitive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sensitive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the musician wrote of a sensitive skin of the child in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the sensitive skin of the child that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too sensitive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a sensitive ear for music, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite sensitive, and everybody laughed.
The sensitive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
